invariants: all public stateful operations use inherent instance methods
encoding emits deterministic RFC 8878 single-segment raw-block frames
decoding accepts raw and RLE blocks incrementally without retaining encoded input
compressed blocks with raw or RLE literals and zero or nonzero sequences decode transactionally from one bounded block buffer
direct-weight Huffman literals decode one-stream and four-stream layouts with exact regenerated-size validation
treeless Huffman literals reuse only a table established earlier in the same frame
sequence tables support predefined RLE FSE-compressed and same-frame repeat modes
sequence decoding reads reverse-interleaved literal offset and match states and validates exact bitstream completion
repeat offsets are frame-local state initialized to 1 4 8 and updated only after a valid sequence block commits
encoded decoded window frame and skippable byte limits are independent domain fields
each data block is bounded by both the frame window and 128 KiB
skippable frame payload is bounded before it is consumed
caller output changes only after every complete data frame and optional content checksum validates
finish consumes affine encoder and decoder instances
content checksum is the low 32 bits of seed-zero XXH64 over decoded frame bytes in little-endian order
encoder checksum policy is an immutable FrameOptions domain value owned by Codec
XXH64 supports bounded 32-byte-stripe streaming without retaining complete input
checksum mismatch has an exact error and preserves caller output transactionality
FSE-compressed Huffman weights and dictionaries fail explicitly
